sources.subject: open-zaak/vng-selectielijst
sources.caveat: Authors of the commits of the last 12 months, told apart by address after the repository's .mailmap. Their organisation is the domain of their address, or for a personal, hidden or noreply address the company on their public profile. The owning organisation (maykinmedia.nl) is the most common organisation domain, the domains and names in publiccode.yml and the owner account; one person with two addresses counts twice. Bots are left out.

results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 6 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 3 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the commits of the last 12 months (35 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is maykinmedia.nl (2 authors), with 94% of the 35 commits whose organisation is known; 0% of the commits come from 0 of 3 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 17 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 11 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: The median time to the first comment or review by someone other than the author, over the 8 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13. 5 got a response; 3 had none yet. Bots are left out.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: None of the 4 latest issues opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 1 final release was published in the last 12 months, counted from the version tags. The latest final release is from 2026-11-03. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.

notes: Measured over the open issues and the issues closed in the last 90 days, in working days (Monday to Friday, Europe/Amsterdam, without Dutch public holidays).

Vulnerabilities are read from the published GitHub security advisories, from draft to publication. Their response time, unpublished advisories and Dependabot alerts need admin rights and are not measured.
